source.note: For proper names absent from LSJ, the pinned formatted source explicitly supplies Abbott-Smith material and marks LSJ absence.

previouslyConfirmed.G2316: Core deity/God-god-divine-being family retained; classical and metaphorical extensions are not auto-promoted without Luke context.
previouslyConfirmed.G0932: Rule/dominion and kingdom/realm boundary retained; unrelated institutional/classical extensions require Luke context.
previouslyConfirmed.G4151: Wind/breath, divine inspiration/Spirit, human spirit, and spiritual-being families retained where context supports them; medical, grammatical, rhetorical and other niche extensions are excluded without Luke evidence.

G3004.boundary: Luke candidate may use context-proven say/speak/tell/call/mean senses. Older gather/pick-up, count, choose and other niche classical senses are not auto-expanded without Luke token evidence.

G4982.boundary: Save/rescue/preserve is the core family; heal/recover and salvation-state senses are retained where Luke context proves them. Legal, technical, memory/maintenance and other broad classical extensions are excluded without context.

G1342.boundary: Center on righteous/just/right according to Luke context. Broader civilized, balanced/equal, exact, fitting/normal/genuine and entitlement constructions require explicit Luke evidence.

G3686.boundary: Center on name/designation and context-proven by-name/call-by-name uses. Fame, pretext, accountancy, technical phrase and grammatical noun senses are excluded unless Luke context proves them.

G3341.boundary: Change of mind/heart, repentance and regret are source-supported. The rhetorical afterthought/correction sense is a separate specialist extension and is not part of the default Luke lexical candidate without contextual evidence.

G3137.boundary: Proper-name identity is Mary with both Maria/Mariam forms. The spelling itself does not identify which Mary is intended; person identity must remain in the context/entity layer rather than the lexical meaning. The pinned source marks LSJ as having no entry and supplies Abbott-Smith NT evidence.

G0002.boundary: Proper name Aaron, indeclinable. Genealogical or priestly relations belong to context/entity data rather than lexical headword expansion. The pinned source marks LSJ as having no entry and supplies Abbott-Smith NT evidence including Luke 1:5.
